Abby continuity when she appears: strawberry-blonde curls, blue eyes, pink-cream-cyan suit
sessionNote: MJ batch moonBase.emotional.v1. Serial only. Submit promptSeeds in order, one job at a time, ≥30s apart (≥120s between four-candidate grids). No auto-reroll. For singles, promptSeeds[0] is the composite to run; later seeds are optional finished-plate alternates. For packs (semanticId starts with pack. or game.), every promptSeed is its own asset. Land originals under AssetSources/MoonBase/emotional-v1/ with job id, candidate index, and sha256. Do not bind into Swift. Do not replace chalk plates.
